name: block_highlight
title: Block Highlight
description: One highlight of a post in a single card, in 4 parts: title (with #anchor id), then text + media (image, image slider and/or video from the post media folder, e.g. highlights/<name>/) side by side through the columns component (default 50-50 from md up, one column below; changeable with data.columns), then optional text_full (rest of a long text, full width), then the tags full width. With "layout": "case_study" (project_page) it is a full-width section instead: a media_grid of its videos / images on one side, label + title + text + tags on the other.
